subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a public channel-plugin capability with Telegram opting in by default, despite changing final-mode delivery semantics and the competing separate-delivery request?
rationale: The contract affects external plugins and changes when core suppresses visible text, so tests cannot decide whether this is the permanent SDK and Telegram UX direction.

options.title: Approve the typed capability
options.body: Accept the public contract and Telegram's default opt-in, contingent on exact-head live proof and green required checks.

options.title: Keep the repair Telegram-owned
options.body: Narrow the implementation to a Telegram-specific internal seam and defer the extension-facing capability until broader channel requirements are established.

options.title: Pause for delivery-mode design
options.body: Coordinate this work with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539 before deciding whether bundled or separate delivery is canonical or configurable.

recommendation.title: Approve the typed capability
recommendation.body: Accept the public contract and Telegram's default opt-in, contingent on exact-head live proof and green required checks.
